footnote_text: The sale represented on this Form 4 was effected pursuant to a previously disclosed Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted by the Reporting Person on August 8, 2025 (the "Trading Plan") for personal tax planning purposes and to satisfy tax obligations.  The Trading Plan covers the sale of up to an aggregate of 584,998 shares of the Issuer's common stock.  All terms of the Trading Plan, including the number of shares to be sold and the minimum sale prices, were fixed at adoption.  This is the Reporting Person's first open-market sale of the Issuer's common stock outside of required sales upon the vesting of equity awards under the Issuer's mandated sell-to-cover program.  As of the date of this filing, the Reporting Person has no other Rule 10b5-1 trading plan in effect. || The reported price in Column 4 is a weighted average price. These shares were sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $21.50 to $21.54 per share. The reporting person undertakes to provide to the Issuer, any security holder of the Issuer, or the staff of the Securities and Exchange Commission, upon request, full information regarding the number of shares sold at each separate price within the range set forth in this footnote.
